title: Build live location tracker with interactive map

requirements.text: Integrate Leaflet.js map library (version 1.9.4) using CDN (https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js and https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css) to render an interactive full-screen map with OpenStreetMap tiles (https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png with maxZoom: 19)
acceptanceCriteria: Map renders at 100vh (full viewport height) and 100% width
OpenStreetMap tiles load correctly with proper attribution
Map is interactive (pan, zoom) using Leaflet controls

requirements.text: Implement browser Geolocation API tracking that continuously watches user position (watch: true), automatically centers the map on user location with zoom level 16, and updates a blue marker as position changes
acceptanceCriteria: Browser requests geolocation permission on page load
Map auto-centers to user's GPS coordinates with zoom level 16
Blue marker appears at user location with 'You are here' popup
Marker position updates in real-time as user moves
Handles location permission denial with appropriate error handling

requirements.text: Display a status overlay box positioned absolutely at top-right (10px from top and right) with white background, rounded corners (5px border-radius), and subtle shadow (0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)) showing: 'Location Tracker' heading, tracking status text ('Waiting for permission...', 'Tracking Active', or 'Error: Location denied'), and live latitude/longitude coordinates formatted to 5 decimal places
acceptanceCriteria: Status box appears at top-right corner with z-index: 1000 to overlay map
Status text updates from 'Waiting for permission...' to 'Tracking Active' when location is acquired
Latitude and longitude display update in real-time showing 5 decimal places
Error state displays 'Error: Location denied' if permission is rejected
Box has white background, 15px padding, 5px border-radius, and box-shadow

requirements.text: Apply a clean, modern minimal design aesthetic with a focus on functional clarity: use a crisp monochrome palette (white UI elements on transparent overlays), sans-serif typography (Arial), and subtle elevation through soft shadows to create visual hierarchy without distraction from the map content
acceptanceCriteria: Status overlay uses white background with subtle shadow for depth
Typography is clear and readable with sans-serif font
Design prioritizes map visibility with minimal UI obstruction
Overall aesthetic is clean and utilitarian

constraints: Must use Leaflet.js version 1.9.4 from unpkg.com CDN
Must use OpenStreetMap tiles as map provider
Must not implement backend location storage or tracking history
Must handle geolocation permission denial gracefully without app crash
nonGoals: Custom map styles beyond OpenStreetMap default
